verdict.rationale: Baseten clearly supports deploying custom/fine-tuned models on dedicated GPUs/infrastructure separate from the shared Model APIs pool (baseten-docs-2, 17, 30, 12), and describes multi-cluster/multi-cloud redundancy with automatic reprovisioning (baseten-docs-15), which implies elastic capacity management. However, the evidence never explicitly names or documents an 'autoscaling' feature/config for dedicated deployments, nor traffic-isolation guarantees in scaling terms. Missing for 10: explicit autoscaling configuration docs (min/max replicas, scale-to-zero, etc.), and concrete isolation/performance guarantees for dedicated vs shared traffic.
